documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the returned item.

documents.title: Shipping times
documents.text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days; express arrives the next day if ordered before noon.

documents.title: Password reset
documents.text: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page; the reset email expires after 30 minutes.

documents.title: Invoices
documents.text: Invoices are available as PDF under Billing, History for the last 24 months.

documents.title: Cancelling a subscription
documents.text: You can cancel anytime under Plan settings; access continues until the end of the billing period.

documents.title: Data export
documents.text: Export all your projects as a ZIP archive from Settings, Data, Export.

documents.title: Two-factor authentication
documents.text: Turn on two-factor authentication with an authenticator app under Security.

documents.title: API rate limits
documents.text: The API allows 600 requests per minute per key; exceeding it returns HTTP 429.

documents.title: Warranty
documents.text: Hardware is covered for two years against manufacturing defects.

documents.title: Account deletion
documents.text: Deleting your account permanently erases your data after a 14-day grace period.

documents.title: Pricing
documents.text: The Pro plan costs 12 EUR per month and adds unlimited projects.

documents.title: Gift cards
documents.text: Gift cards never expire and can be combined with other promotions.

documents.title: Digital downloads
documents.text: Refunds are not possible for digital downloads once they have been opened.

documents.title: Shipping to islands
documents.text: Express shipping is unavailable to islands; parcels there go by standard delivery.

documents.title: Forgotten username
documents.text: If you can't remember your username, sign in with your email address instead.

documents.title: Disputed charges
documents.text: To dispute a charge from last year, contact your bank; we cannot reverse card payments older than 120 days.

documents.title: Renewal reminders
documents.text: We email you seven days before your membership renews, with the amount we will charge.

documents.title: Storage limits
documents.text: Each account can store up to 50 GB; extra copies of large files count toward the limit.

documents.title: Promo codes
documents.text: Add a promo code at checkout to get an extra 10 percent off your first order.

documents.title: API error codes
documents.text: The API returns HTTP 401 when a key is missing and HTTP 404 when a resource does not exist.

documents.title: Accidental damage
documents.text: Damage from drops or spills is not covered; a broken screen can be repaired for a fee.

documents.title: Profile photo
documents.text: Remove or replace your profile photo at any time under Account, Profile.

documents.title: Free plan
documents.text: The free tier costs nothing each month and includes three projects.

documents.title: Gift card refunds
documents.text: Gift cards cannot be refunded or exchanged for cash.
